cards.text: Friend, it's feast time in Jerusalem, and people have come up to worship. Some of them are Greeks. They walk right up to Philip, one of Jesus' disciples, who's from Bethsaida in Galilee.

cards.question: The Greeks at the feast have one request for Philip. What do they want?

answers.text: To find a place to stay

cards.question: Philip doesn't take the Greeks' request straight to Jesus. He relays it to ___, another of Jesus' disciples, first.

cards.text: Then Philip and Andrew BOTH go tell Jesus. One request, two disciples. That's every adult who's ever told a coworker, "Walk with me to the boss's office. You don't have to talk. Just STAND there."
Jesus doesn't answer with a yes or a no. He says, “The hour has come for the Son of Man to be glorified.”

cards.question: Next Jesus gives a picture of a kernel of wheat falling to the ground. What does He say has to happen to it before it bears much fruit?

cards.text: Unless the kernel dies, it remains only a seed. Same in my bakery, friend: dough that never goes in the oven stays DOUGH. You can stare at that bowl all week. Cookie count? ZERO.

cards.question: Jesus turns from the seed to people. He says whoever loves his life will keep it. True or false?

cards.text: Flipped! Whoever loves his life will lose it, but whoever hates his life in this world will keep it for eternal life. Then Jesus talks about anyone who serves Him.

cards.question: Jesus says anyone who serves Him must ___ Him, and where He is, His servant will be as well.
Jesus says the one who serves Him will be honored. Who does He say will honor him?

cards.text: Then Jesus says something you might not expect. “Now My soul is troubled, and what shall I say?”

cards.question: Jesus wonders whether He should ask the Father to save Him from this hour. Then He asks the Father for exactly that. True or false?

cards.text: No. Jesus says it is for this purpose that He has come to this hour. So He prays, “Father, glorify Your name!”

cards.question: Jesus has just prayed for the Father to glorify His name. What happens right after?

cards.text: The voice says, “I have glorified it, and I will glorify it again.” Friend, when heaven answers out loud, you stop stamping and you LISTEN.
So a voice just came from heaven, and the crowd standing there heard it. But they can't agree on what it was.

cards.question: Some in the crowd say it had thundered. Others say ___ had spoken to Jesus.

cards.text: Some say thunder, some say angel, and that's every house after a loud noise at night: one person says “just the wind,” and the other one is ALREADY holding a flashlight. Then Jesus speaks up.

cards.question: Jesus tells the crowd the voice from heaven came for His benefit, not theirs. True or false?

cards.text: The voice was for them. Then Jesus says, “Now judgment is upon this world; now the prince of this world will be cast out.”

cards.question: Next Jesus talks about being lifted up from the earth. When He is, what does He say He will do?
The passage stops to explain that Jesus spoke of being lifted up to show the kind of death He was going to die. True or false?

cards.text: The crowd has a problem. They've heard from the Law that the Christ will remain forever, so how can the Son of Man be lifted up?

cards.question: The crowd can't make the Law and Jesus' words about being lifted up fit together. What do they ask Him?

answers.text: Who this Son of Man is
Where He plans to go next

cards.text: That's the face of somebody whose GPS just said “turn left” and there's a LAKE on the left. Then Jesus tells them, “For a little while longer, the Light will be among you.”

cards.question: Jesus tells the crowd to walk while they have the Light, so that ___ will not overtake them.

cards.text: Jesus says, “The one who walks in the darkness does not know where he is going.” Every adult alive has walked through the house at night with the lights off and found the corner of the couch with their pinky toe.

cards.question: While the crowd still has the Light, Jesus tells them to wait for it to come back later. True or false?
Jesus tells the crowd to believe in the Light while they have it. What does He say they may become?
After Jesus has spoken these things to the crowd, what does He do?

answers.text: He goes away and is hidden from them
He stays and heals the sick among them
He goes up to teach in the temple

findings.problem: This story card has three sentences: 'Then Philip and Andrew BOTH go tell Jesus.' 'One request, two disciples.' 'That's every adult who's ever told a coworker...' Only the opening card may run to 3 sentences.

rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.

findings.problem: The wrong answer 'An angel appears beside Him' sits close to verse 29, where some in the crowd say an angel had spoken to Jesus. A baker could argue it is right. It also blurs the next stop's question, where 'an angel' is the right answer.

rule.text: No near-matches. A wrong answer never means the same as the right answer, or close to it. If a baker could argue it's right, replace it.

findings.problem: The closing line 'when heaven answers out loud, you stop stamping and you LISTEN' reads like a nice dad being pleasant. It is not a real laugh. The moment could carry a stronger line without muddying the fact.

rule.text: If a line reads like a nice dad being pleasant, push it further.
